note: Surface forms that denote the same skill. Kept deliberately narrow: every entry is an assertion that two names mean the same competence, and that assertion has to survive a reviewer asking why. This is the auditable alternative to a similarity threshold — 'PostgreSQL and Postgres are the same product, here is the list' can be defended to a rejected candidate; '0.87 cosine similarity' cannot.
not_aliases: Dialects and adjacent-but-distinct tools are deliberately absent. T-SQL is not SQL-the-skill for scoring purposes, LangGraph is not LangChain, and JSON Schema is not JSON. Widening this file is a scoring change and should be reviewed as one.
